The holding is present, but the literal uses '[partly old]' brackets. Under the supplied conventions, brackets signal uncertainty, not interlinear position. The two-line pencil incipit is present. The punctuation after 'bhūtvā' looks more like a point or small stroke than a clear '/'. This should be flagged as uncertain. The attachment to c.360(6) on fol. 8 by the level arrow is probable.
